gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-lisu-bosa: Spaced-out letters glowing like neon tubes. Neuropolitical stays flat and compass-drawn, while Lisu Bosa, a classic serif, has sturdy hairlines beside moderate stems, so paragraphs of it read steadily and feel substantial.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-montagu-sla: Neuropolitical pulls its words apart letter by letter, every stroke glowing like neon tube at a single thickness, with no hairlines anywhere. Montagu Slab's sturdy downstrokes and slender turns keep long stretches comfortable.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-noto-serif-: Noto Serif Hentaigana carries a subtle gradient of weight along each curve, with small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals. Neuropolitical keeps flat lines; this body reads softly across paragraphs.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-ovo: Ovo keeps its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. But Neuropolitical, cut like ribbon of constant width, sets a crisp modern tone that Ovo softens below.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-domine: Domine breathes inside every curve, its compact ascenders rising over tall lowercase, with a slight pinch where curves meet stems. Nordic, closed and monoweight, makes that openness stand out.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-esteban: Powerful and ancient, Nordic sits tight and closed, each stroke held to one steady technical-pen width. Esteban opens right up, its oversized lowercase and unsqueezed e standing in sharp contrast to Nordic's tight forms.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-faustina: Faustina reads with bowls that thin gracefully, an open-jawed c, and capitals sitting just above the lowercase. Nordic does best with constant pen width and closed forms, while Faustina is best at a smooth, modest gradient.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-halant: Ancient and powerful, Nordic stays tight and closed. Halant, a classic serif, flares terminals outward like tongs and towers in x-height, with a mellow swing between its thicks and thins.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-hedvig-letters-seri: Hedvig Letters Serif leaves its curves open-ended with room to breathe, stands tall and sturdy in the lowercase, and keeps stroke contrast modest. Hedvig Letters Serif stays open wherever Nordic stays tightly closed.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-lisu-bosa: Editorial in tone, Lisu Bosa spills its counters out into the space around them. Nordic, smooth and closed, would crowd if made small, while the serif's slight but noticeable contrast holds up large.
